title: Juicy Chinese Pork Stir-fry
description: A resinous, creamy sweet-and-sour pork stir-fry with baby lettuce leaves, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot and FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Heat the ttukbaegi over medium heat and add the sesame oil.
Add the minced ginger and garlic-infused oil and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the sliced pork and sear until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the julienned carrot and sliced bell pepper, stir-frying for 2 minutes.
Pour the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar over the mixture and toss to coat evenly.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with water to create a glossy sauce, cooking for another 2 minutes until thickened.
Fold in the baby lettuce leaves and cook just until they wilt, about 1 minute.
Serve hot straight from the ttukbaegi, spooning the sauce over the pork and lettuce.
